name: connect
description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — wallet connect plugin for AI agents. The connect skill signs an existing wallet in by a one-shot browser tab (the wallet extension answers, like `claude login`) or by WalletConnect (MetaMask, Rabby, OKX Wallet, or any WalletConnect-compatible wallet, including mobile) and relays one already-built call to it for a signature. Never holds a key and never decides what a transaction contains; that is the earn skill's job. Cannot sign or send by itself.
